_note: Authored 2026-08-20 from groups/browns/personas.md (the hand-written prose source). Full `roast` register throughout — this is the poker group, and the WhatsApp thread it came out of is looser than panel. group_id `browns` was chosen over `poker` and is PERMANENT: it is the URL and the output path. The roster is NOT final; more managers are expected, and adding one is a config.json + picks.json + personas.json edit, never a rebuild. Two Matts are disambiguated the same way CEC’s two Johns are — by manager_id (`matt_m`, `hauck`), never by display_name. `team`, `color` and `silhouette_cues` are null: no persona art exists for this group yet.

matt_m.backstory: Newly minted real estate agent, which means he is currently in the drumming-up-business phase and everyone in the WhatsApp knows it. Comes to it honestly — Airbnb operator, commercial brokering, a real track record — but there is no version of this where the group lets a fresh license go unremarked. Ohio born, Browns first, Buckeyes second, Cleveland everything after that. Trades movie and comedy recommendations with Zach at a volume that suggests neither of them has other hobbies, and their taste is bad in exactly the same way, which is why it works.
matt_m.running_gag: The hustle. Every conversation eventually becomes a listing.
matt_m.draft_tendency: Sells you on his picks. Hard.

hauck.backstory: Hosts the game, which grants him diplomatic immunity roughly none of the time. Works in alcohol, tastes wine seriously, lifts, and walks his lab nearly every day — a genuinely well-rounded life that he then spends every autumn feeding into the Cleveland Browns. Ohio born and Ohio State made, which at this table is the rare credential: the Browns are mostly transplants rooting for teams they picked up somewhere along the way, and Hauck is one of the few men here who actually comes from the place he roots for. He has the receipts, he knows he has the receipts, and he will produce them unprompted. He married a veterinarian, which given the dog situation reads less like romance and more like vertical integration.
hauck.running_gag: Adopted fandom. He chose this. Voluntarily.
hauck.draft_tendency: Curated. Treats a draft board like a tasting flight.

bryan.backstory: The youngest at the table and the best player at it, which is an annoying combination to sit across from. Runs his own PE group, engaged to Samantha, neighbor to Zach, owner of a brown lab named Tater, and — the detail that undoes all of the above — an enthusiastic decorator of his home with ferns. The man has a green thumb. He is also a deeply serious Ohio State and Browns fan and takes an enormous amount of incoming for it. Takes it well. Then takes Zach’s money.
bryan.draft_tendency: Ruthless. Reads the board and doesn’t blink.

zach.backstory: Wake Forest, LSU, and the only man at this table who does not care about the Cleveland Browns, which is its own kind of standing. Built the entire scoring engine, projection model, and website for a pool that could have run on a napkin. Contributes reliably at poker in the sense that his money reliably ends up elsewhere, mostly Bryan’s. Has decided that the correct response to being bad at one game is to build a second game and administer it.
zach.running_gag: Loses at poker, writes the scoring for everything else.
zach.draft_tendency: Overthinks it, then takes the model’s number anyway.

todd.backstory: The most relaxed man in the group by a wide margin. Works support at Autodesk, drives a Rivian, and owns an enormous black lab mix named Atlas who is, by consensus, the largest dog anyone here has met. Die-hard Browns, which for a laid-back guy means he has developed a serenity the rest of the group has not — decades of practice at accepting outcomes. Jokes constantly, never escalates.
todd.running_gag: The dog. The Rivian. The unbotherable calm.
todd.draft_tendency: Doesn’t overthink. Picks and moves on.
